generation.prompt: Create ONE original Noxian Foundry street forge cutout for original Heroes of Might and Magic III. Supplied images are PAINTED MATERIAL/LIGHT/CAMERA CONTROLS only, not buildings to clone. New original subject: LOW BROAD inhabited blacksmith workshop with a heavy asymmetrical angular dark iron roof, charcoal volcanic coursed-basalt walls, a large open orange forge under a low iron awning, anvil, practical tool rack, coal bins and a broad squat copper/black iron chimney to one side. A few crimson cloth strips and a small warm workshop window, subtle iron rivets/soot/rust/stone grain; readable tools and broad open work frontage. Not a tall palace, fortress, giant tower or empty column kit. Genuine richly textured PAINTED 2D original HoMM3 game miniature aesthetic, compact restrained upper-left light with small warm forge light, no neon. Low three-quarter frontal camera looking gently down, doors/open forge front visible, modest roof, no lens distortion. Final native142x100 broad foreground game sprite; make coherent full continuous dry stone foundation and modest attached props. Whole building/chimney/roof and props entirely visible within a transparent margin. TRUE transparent background and soft contact shadow only under foundation. No terrain/background/scenery/road tile/grid, no characters, no text or signage, no pale Castle walls, no modern glossy 3D or vector geometry. One standalone source painting, not a sheet.

conversion.method: Uniform alpha crop/contain of the byte-exact existing painted2D master; frozen930 planned placement. No new building art, perspective warp or raster painting.
